program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_b@i & !is_bos@j & is_c@j | !is_b@i & !is_bos@j, is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_bos@j | !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & is_c@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(true, !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_c@j | is_a@i & !is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j)
h3_1 = rightmost(h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & h2_1@j | !is_bos@i & h1_1@i & !is_bos@j, !h2_1@i & !is_c@j | !h2_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_c@j)
h4_1 = rightmost(is_c@i & h2_1@i & !h3_1@i & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & is_c@j | is_a@i & h2_1@i & !h3_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j & !h1_1@j & !h2_1@j, h2_1@i & !h3_1@i | !is_b@i & !h3_1@i)
accept = !is_b & h2_1 & !h3_1 & h4_1

output accept
